label: Kodex compact on-device language model

architecture.quantization: per-tensor int8 weights for mobile inference

notes: The model has exactly 264192 trainable parameters before int8 quantization; this is not a count of biological or literal neurons.
The compact model is a functional language-model experiment trained from random initialization, not a capable medium-scale or frontier model.
The curated training corpus is small and Portuguese-focused; answers may be repetitive, incorrect, or nonsensical.
The APK build trains the model and embeds quantized weights as kodex-model.js for local inference without a remote model API.
The Build mode prepares a text proposal only; it does not edit the repository, run commands, or provide a sandbox.
The conversation fallback handles basic greetings and very short messages when neural output fails basic quality checks.
